lines.zh: 我贴着洞壁，慢慢滚过去。
lines.en: I hug the cave wall and roll slowly closer.

lines.zh: 眼球贴着岩壁一路滚过去。
lines.en: The eye rolls along the cavern wall.

lines.zh: 一层膜张开又合上，我在挪动。
lines.en: A lid parts and shuts as I shift along.
Rumble, waiting for the right moment.

lines.zh: 眼睛模糊了，看不清路了！
我迷路了，找不到回去的路！
我被什么东西撞了，好痛！
我的视线被遮住了，看不见！
我的视线被干扰了，好难受！
我快看不见了，我快不行了！

lines.en: The light you emit attracted me!

lines.zh: 你手里那块肉，晃得我眼花。
lines.en: That meat in your hand dazzles my eye.

lines.zh: 你掏出的东西，我全看见了。
lines.en: I see everything you pull out.

lines.zh: 那味道让我滚出了洞穴。
lines.en: That smell rolls me out of my cave.
I know the smell of a torch.

lines.zh: 你的膝盖磕在我的眼球上。
lines.en: Your knee knocks against my eyeball.

lines.zh: 我的眼白蹭上了你的灰。
lines.en: My eye white smears with your dust.

lines.zh: 地下的眼睛睁开就不会闭。
lines.en: An underground eye that never shuts.

lines.zh: 你撞上我，像撞进一团雾。
lines.en: You hit me as if plunging into fog.

lines.zh: 一只眼睛也在找另一只。
lines.en: One eye is looking for another.
Underground, I am the only eye.

lines.zh: 地下这么黑，我只有一只眼。
lines.en: It's so dark underground, and I've only one eye.

lines.zh: 我是唯一的伴侣，找到我！
lines.en: I am the only one, find me!

lines.zh: 再找一只眼，两只一起看。
lines.en: One more eye, so we can watch together.
My mate and I are together!
You smell its腐烂气息rotting scent.

lines.zh: 我把亮东西吸进眼眶里。
lines.en: I draw the shiny thing into my socket.

lines.zh: 它的眼中映出你的影子。
我的目光落在你脚边那块东西上。
lines.en: My gaze settles on that thing by your feet.
Its sight cuts through the darkness.

lines.zh: 它的目光像是要穿透你。
lines.en: Its gaze seems to pierce you.

lines.zh: 它盯上了一个新的目标。
lines.en: It locks onto a new target.
Its gaze is fixed on you.

lines.zh: 我的独眼已经对准你的胸口。
lines.en: My single eye is fixed on your chest.
Its sight is locked on you.
It starts paying attention to your whereabouts.

lines.zh: 它的目光中透露出恶意。
有脚步声从上面传下来。
你的火把让我眨了一下。
lines.en: Your torch makes me blink once.

lines.zh: 在这片黑里，只有你在动。
lines.en: In all this dark, only you are moving.

lines.zh: 瞳孔缩了一下，是你进来了。
lines.en: My pupil contracts — you have come in.

lines.zh: 我看见你的影子比你先到。
lines.en: I see your shadow arrive before you.

lines.zh: 地下很静，你的呼吸太响。
lines.en: The deep is quiet; your breathing is loud.

lines.zh: 我的瞳孔收得只剩一线。
lines.en: My pupil tightens to a single line.
The eye opens, aimed right at you.

lines.zh: 它的眼中透露出攻击欲望。
lines.en: Its eyes reveal a desire to attack.
Its gaze is like a sword.
It prepares to pierce you with its gaze.
Its gaze is filled with malice.
I center my pupil on you.
You go left; my gaze follows left.
Your torch shakes — you are nervous.

lines.zh: 我看得见你身后的黑暗。
lines.en: I can see the dark behind you.
My gaze fills every crack in the rock.
You hug the wall; I watch the wall.
Don't look for the exit; I am watching it.

lines.zh: 你一闭眼，我就靠近一点。
lines.en: Every time you blink, I come closer.
The white of my eye outshines your torch.

lines.zh: 你退一步，我往前滚一寸。
lines.en: You step back; I roll an inch forward.
Stare at you with big eyes
Rips at your clothes with claws
I tear my lid open and lunge!
My pupil clenches and all light dies!

lines.zh: 滚到你脚边，撞你的小腿！
lines.en: I roll to your feet and strike your shin!
One hard stare and your balance fails!

lines.zh: 眼里的红光扫过你的脸！
lines.en: Red light from my eye sweeps your face!
I slam hard into your knee!
Don't blink — blinking costs you a hit!

lines.zh: 眼白一翻，你的影子碎了！
lines.en: My eye rolls white and your shadow shatters!
I drink the torchlight into my pupil!

lines.zh: 这一下，专挑你看不见的角！
lines.en: This blow comes from the angle you can't see!

lines.zh: 洞里睁开一只，只有一只眼。
lines.en: In the cave, one eye opens. Only one.
In the black underground, I open my eye.

lines.zh: 黑暗里浮起一只眼，那是我。
lines.en: An eye floats up out of the dark — that is me.

lines.zh: 岩层裂开，我从缝里挤出来。
lines.en: The stone splits and I squeeze out of the seam.

lines.zh: 我从高处摔了下来，好疼！
雷光把我的瞳孔照得发白。
lines.en: The lightning bleaches my pupil white.
